title: goniopteris penangiana

It is native to Malaysia and is traditionally used in medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and make it a subject of ongoing research.
